resources.string: Google Translate web using the InstantTranslate method (experimental). This test build includes a web service credential, not a personal Cloud API key. This unofficial endpoint can change or stop working. Powered by Google Translate.

When translation is requested, spoken text is sent to Google. It may include messages, names, notifications or financial information. Password and Android-marked sensitive fields, excluded apps and the lock screen are not translated. These checks cannot identify every private text. Only enable translation when you know what will be read. Nothing is sent while translation is off, except when you request a single translation. Cached text stays in memory only.
Translate speech until turned off. Off after restarting or disabling the reader. Paused while locked. Voice input, braille and app text stay unchanged.
Assign both actions in Gestures, under Reading controls. No existing gesture is changed. You can also use the Can Talk menu.
Memory only, up to 500 entries and 512,000 characters; expires after 24 hours. Cleared when the reader stops or translation settings change. Successful results only; protected fields are excluded.
Clears the last app outside Can Talk. In shared mode this clears the whole shared cache.
Selected apps are excluded from both translation modes. Android may limit which installed apps appear here.
Allow online translation in Translation settings first.
